run_train_gan_model: run the GAN training script with argparse flags like --cuda --num_epochs 1500 --batchsize 32
run_get_optimizer: run get_optimizer to create Adam, RMSprop, Adagrad, or SGD optimizers for G and D networks
run_save_optimizer: run save_optimizer to persist discriminator and generator optimizer state dicts to disk
run_get_zdist: run get_zdist to create a uniform or Gaussian latent variable distribution for GAN sampling
run_train_epoch: run train_epoch to perform one epoch of discriminator and generator training steps
